label: 038 post-hoc addition: cross-asset inputs and 2-4 day horizons
status: POST-HOC: added after the 038 verdicts and earlier follow-ups were read, at the user's request (literature.md: cross-asset lagged returns are the published intraday crypto edge; crypto momentum lives at longer horizons). Committed before any of these results. Same rule, costs, eligibility, trade simulation (one position per pair, entry next open, held N candles), benchmark, bootstrap and decision as preregistration.json.
horizon_note: 2, 3, 4 days; one position per pair at a time, so trades per half shrink with N (min_trades_per_half 200 still applies)
inputs_X: btc_ret_k (BTC/USDT trailing log return) and mkt_ret_k (equal-weight mean of the OTHER nine pairs' trailing log returns), rel_ret_k (own minus mkt) for k in 1, 4, 16, 64; mkt_disp_16 (cross-sectional std of the other pairs' 16-candle returns). NaN where a source has no real candle; rows need finite own inputs only. Causality tested (tests/test_frames.py::test_cross_asset_inputs_are_causal).

lgb_LX.seed: a PASS needs a seed-2 PASS

lgb_L_long.seed: a PASS needs a seed-2 PASS

lgb_null_long.features: L, targets permuted per training span
lgb_null_long.role: null control at long horizons; a PASS downgrades every learned PASS

holt_w288.params: Holt(damped_trend=True, initialization_method='estimated') on 288 log closes (3 days); no detrending/smoothing

baselines: zero and hist_mean rescored on all 11 horizons (identical values at 1..96)
